title: BattINFO Organization
description: Canonical organization record (manufacturer, research lab, university, etc.) using schema.org Organization terms.

schema_version.description: Version of the record schema this document conforms to (semantic versioning); stamped by the library on save.

id.description: Canonical IRI of this organization record.

name.description: Current preferred name of the organization.

handle.description: Short readable slug, unique within one registry workspace (e.g. 'flores-ocv/graphite-aq-1-063b77-cell'). Display text, never part of the identity.

legalName.description: DEPRECATED alias of `legal_name` (pre-snake_case spelling): accepted forever, normalized on round-trip, never taught.

alternateName.description: DEPRECATED alias of `alternate_name` (pre-snake_case spelling): accepted forever, normalized on round-trip, never taught.

same_as.description: Canonical external IRIs (Wikidata, ROR, GRID, LEI) that identify this organization.

addressCountry.description: DEPRECATED alias of `address_country`: accepted forever, normalized on round-trip, never taught.

addressRegion.description: DEPRECATED alias of `address_region`: accepted forever, normalized on round-trip, never taught.

addressLocality.description: DEPRECATED alias of `address_locality`: accepted forever, normalized on round-trip, never taught.

foundingDate.description: DEPRECATED alias of `founding_date` (pre-snake_case spelling): accepted forever, normalized on round-trip, never taught.

dissolutionDate.description: DEPRECATED alias of `dissolution_date` (pre-snake_case spelling): accepted forever, normalized on round-trip, never taught.

id.description: Canonical IRI of the parent organization record.

parentOrganization.description: DEPRECATED alias of `parent_organization` (pre-snake_case spelling): accepted forever, normalized on round-trip, never taught.

legal_name.description: Full legal name, if different from name.

alternate_name.description: Former names, abbreviations, or brand names (e.g. 'LG Chem' for LG Energy Solution).

founding_date.description: Year or ISO 8601 date the organization was founded.

dissolution_date.description: Year or ISO 8601 date the organization was dissolved, if applicable.

id.description: Canonical IRI of the parent organization record.

parent_organization.description: Parent organization, if this is a subsidiary or division.

organization.description: The organization being described, in schema.org Organization terms.

source_type.description: Kind of source this record was created from.

source_url.description: URL of the source document or landing page, when available.

retrieved_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC) when the source was retrieved or the record was captured.

battinfo_version.description: Version of the battinfo library that wrote this record (semantic versioning); stamped on save.

provenance.description: Where the information in this record came from: source type, file or URL, citation, and retrieval time.

editorial.description: Internal editorial metadata — not forwarded to the registry semantic payload.

notes.description: Free-text notes carried with the record.

OrganizationIri.description: Canonical BattINFO IRI in the organization/ namespace (https://w3id.org/battinfo/organization/xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).

ShortId.description: Short human-friendly identifier derived from the record IRI (Crockford base32, 6-16 characters).

Handle.description: Short readable slug for this record, unique within one registry workspace and shown as <workspace>/<handle> (e.g. 'flores-ocv/graphite-aq-1-063b77-cell'). Lowercase ASCII segments joined by '/', each made of letters and digits separated by single hyphens; at most 120 characters. Display text only: the record's identity is its IRI, and a handle may be corrected without moving it. Build one with battinfo.naming.handle_for().

UnixTime.description: Unix timestamp in whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.
